request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. The Silent Toll and Crimson Thread themes finally sound fully at the same time as an intelligible double counterpoint. Add harp, bronze bell, cello, celesta, broken strings and low horn one by one; every lost voice can answer. Begin D minor, earn a Picardy D major ending and allow the motif its full resolution. Tender luminous chamber ensemble, restrained wordless choir, no trailer climax. Only wordless humming or vowel choir as specified; NO intelligible words, lyrics, speech or narration. This is a complete one-shot cue: finish deliberately and let the last resonance decay within the duration.
